value: An Act for making the River Idle navigable, from East-Retford in the County of Nottingham, to Bawtry Wharf in the County of York, 6 Geo. II, c.30
notes: The source dates the Act 1720 but cites 6 Geo. II, which is 1732-33; 6 Geo. I is 1719-20. Kept as the source gives it, not corrected. An Act is evidence of an intention (lease or easement, by a municipal corporation: the source's L and M), not that the river was made navigable. From East Retford to Bawtry, it takes in reaches 1 to 5 of this stretch: Bawtry lies on reach 5.
